label: React Native
summary: React Native components styled with StyleSheet. Layout is flexbox with a column main axis by default; sizes are density-independent points, not CSS pixels. Design tokens live in one theme object that components read.

elements.frame: A View. Use a ScrollView or FlatList when the content is taller than the frame and the spec says it scrolls.
elements.group: A View with no style of its own.
elements.text: A Text. Set fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight and letterSpacing from the text style.
elements.image: An Image (expo-image in an Expo project) with resizeMode cover or contain.
elements.icon: The icon of the same name from the project's icon set (lucide-react-native or @expo/vector-icons).
elements.vector: An SvgXml or Svg Path from react-native-svg with the path data from the spec.
elements.rect: A View with backgroundColor and borderRadius.
elements.ellipse: A View with borderRadius half its size.
elements.instance: The project's component of the same name, with the instance's props.

layout.grid: No grid: rows of Views, or a FlatList with numColumns equal to the frame's columns.
layout.none: position: 'relative' on the frame; children with an absolute position use position: 'absolute' with left and top from x and y.
layout.padding: padding: N, paddingVertical and paddingHorizontal for two values, paddingTop paddingRight paddingBottom paddingLeft for four.
layout.fill: flex: 1 along the parent's main axis, alignSelf: 'stretch' across it.
layout.hug: No width or height; the content decides.

tokens.reference: Read tokens from the theme object (theme.colors.primary, theme.spacing[4]), never write the value in a style.
tokens.naming: A token name's slashes become object keys: color/primary is theme.color.primary, space/4 is theme.space[4].
tokens.modes: Theme values such as Dark select the dark theme object; choose it with useColorScheme. Never branch on the theme in a component.

components: One component per component in the spec, with its props as typed props and its variants as a variant prop. An instance is that component with the instance's props, not a copy of its layers.
rules: Follow the spec's sizes and spacing exactly; they are points.
Build styles with StyleSheet.create outside the render function.
Respect safe areas on frames that touch a screen edge (react-native-safe-area-context).
Use theme tokens for every color, spacing and radius the spec names a token for.
A layer with notes in the spec carries instructions from the designer; follow them.
